svg.title: Kartik Gaikwad — GitHub profile
svg.desc: Kartik Gaikwad — Full-Stack, Frontend, Backend and AI/ML Engineer from Pune, India. B.E. Electronics and Telecommunication student at PICT Pune; SDE Intern at Bluestock Fintech and Research Intern in backend and DevOps. Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Python, FastAPI, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker. Projects: AEGIS, a safety checkpoint for AI-agent payments, and Studio Oak, a full-stack e-commerce platform that won IEEE TechRush.

g.text: E&TC @ PICT Pune · IEEE TechRush Winner
